long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Clay is good, and I will take a piece of it before anyone else thinks of it.
One piece of clay becomes a figure at the workbench, and I will keep the result where I can see it.
The new figure is mine, and the claim should be on record.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will read how they manage it.
steps.topic: how seeds stay dormant until they grow

steps.reason: I will draw what I learned about seeds before I forget it.
The moon is hiding something, and I want to know what somebody has already noticed about it.
The lookout rock is mine, and I want to sit above the beach and see who is coming up it.
Enough thinking for one morning, and the sun is warm.

today.reason: The bowl is empty until I wake tomorrow, so I have removed the step that depended on it and kept the rest of the day as it was.
